name: Gameday Men’s Health
nap_conflict_note: Listed as Thornton in copy, Northglenn in the footer, Westminster on Yelp.

visit_facts.parking: Free surface lot directly in front of the suite. No garage, no meters.
visit_facts.suite: Building 10701, third floor, Suite 315. Elevator on the right as you enter.
visit_facts.draw: The blood draw is a single standard venipuncture. About 40 seconds.
visit_facts.duration: First visit runs 45–60 minutes. Follow-ups are usually under 25.
visit_facts.privacy: Private consult rooms. Nobody else is in the room. No waiting-room sign-in sheet.
visit_facts.cost: Cash-pay. Price is confirmed before anything is drawn or administered.
